# devicons

Icon font, CSS, and SVG sprite for developers.

- Website: https://devicons.io
- Documentation: https://devicons.io/docs/icon-font

## Install

```sh
npm install devicons
```

See the [icon font docs](https://devicons.io/docs/icon-font) for usage.
